name: Carrion Defense Works Tactical Smoke Grenade TSG-5
product_name: Carrion Defense Works Tactical Smoke Grenade TSG-5
description: A military-grade smoke grenade producing a dense, multi-spectrum obscurant cloud that blocks visual, thermal, and laser observation simultaneously. The TSG-5 generates a 20-meter smoke screen lasting 90 seconds using a combination of hexachloroethane smoke and metallic chaff that attenuates infrared and laser wavelengths. The smoke is non-toxic but extremely dense, reducing visibility to less than 1 meter within the cloud. The grenade is standard equipment for tactical retreat, casualty evacuation, and movement concealment.

specifications.toxicity: Non-toxic but respiratory irritant in concentration
specifications.wind resistance: Effective in winds up to 15 km/h

story_hooks: Six TSG-5 grenades deployed simultaneously created a 120-meter smoke screen that blinded every sensor in a corporate perimeter for 90 seconds — the breach team was inside before the smoke cleared.
A modified TSG-5 has been developed that produces smoke with embedded conductive particles — the cloud jams wireless communications in addition to blocking observation.

physical_description.visual_profile: Cylindrical canister with ribbed grip section and pull-ring activation mechanism. Compact, designed for belt carry or vest attachment. Metallic body with a domed fuse cap and safety pin loop.
physical_description.weight_description: Handheld (300g) — easily pocketable or worn on tactical harness
physical_description.primary_material: Zinc alloy body with steel fuse assembly
physical_description.finish: Matte tactical finish with light surface texture to prevent slipping
physical_description.color_scheme: Muted olive-drab green body, black ribbed grip section, silver fuse cap, yellow safety pin
physical_description.interface_elements: Pull-ring attached to safety pin, ribbed grip panels for secure handling, embossed directional arrows indicating safe throwing direction, recessed fuse well
distinctive_features: Radial ribbing along grip zone for wet/gloved operation
Bright yellow safety pin contrasts sharply against drab body
CDW manufacturer stamp in military-spec serif font
Small perforated vents near base for chaff dispersal
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: CARRION DEFENSE WORKS / TSG-5 / MULTI-SPEC / 90SEC / Φ2,400 price code / military regulation stamps
physical_description.condition_typical: Clean, slightly weathered grip tape on sides, minor scuffs from equipment contact, fuse mechanism pristine and ready for deployment
